newsitem.title: USA: NYC to issue $605 mln of GOs in Q3 FY 1997 - mayor.
newsitem.headline: NYC to issue $605 mln of GOs in Q3 FY 1997 - mayor.

text.p: New York City plans to issue about $605 million of general obligation bonds in the third quarter of the 1997 fiscal year, according to Mayor Rudolph Giuliani's new budget plan for fiscal 1998.
The Administration's plan for the new fiscal year, which starts on July 1, calls for the city to sell about $358 million of general obligations in the 1997 fourth quarter.

New York City is expected to hit its state-imposed limit on debt about one month before the 1998 fiscal year begins, and Giuliani urged Albany makers to approve a new finance authority that would allow it to sidestep the debt cap.
The Water Finance Authority is expected to sell about $300 million of debt in April, and to take part in a $60 million borrowing by the Environmental Facilities Corp this spring.
The Authority also plans to raise its tax-exempt commercial paper program to $600 million from $400 million in February.
